description: T03 drag ruler with budget colouring, driven through the live UI. The Blade Champion (M6", Normal move, so RulesEngine.movement_drag_budget gives M 6" + Advance 6" before any roll) has a terrain-free lane straight down from (120,100). Part A: click the unit, screenshot the static board, dispatch BEGIN_MODEL_DRAG (expect success), then move the real cursor (buttonless motion events, the path a keyboard-held pick-up takes) to (a) 4", (b) 9" and (c) 14" from the pickup: current_drag_segments ends CONFIRMED_GREEN / MARGINAL_YELLOW / INVALID_RED, every run's distance_inches is within 0.1" of the expected cut (6" and 12"), the cumulative label at the cursor reads 4.0" / 9.0" Advance / 14.0" out of reach, and the ghost stays clamped at 6" while the ruler runs on to the cursor. drag_path pixel diffs: (a) vs (c) > 5% (path visibly changed) and the static before vs (a) > 2% (path drawn). ESC then cancels: no drag, no ruler, no label, no ghost, nothing staged, the Settings menu NOT opened (Main used to turn that ESC into the pause menu with the model still held), and the drag_path strip is back to the static before (< 2%). Part B: a real mouse drag (button held) 3" down, SHIFT drops a waypoint on the ghost, the cursor turns 3" east (two green 3" runs), ENTER commits: the phase records the path-summed 6.0" (crow-flies would be 4.24"), the model is staged at (240,220), the phase is still Movement (ENTER did not end it) and the later mouse release stages nothing more.

steps.script:
# Clamp ON (the shipped default) and frame the lane: the Blade Champion at
# screen (760,160), 14" down at y 832 — the drag_path region is that strip.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.2
m.view_offset = Vector2(120.0 - 760.0 / 1.2, 100.0 - 160.0 / 1.2)
m.update_view_transform()
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range

# Two legs through the corner, both inside M: green 3" + green 3".
var segs: Array = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller.current_drag_segments
return segs.size() == 2 and segs[0].color_slot == "CONFIRMED_GREEN" and segs[1].color_slot == "CONFIRMED_GREEN" and abs(segs[0].distance_inches - 3.0) <= 0.1 and abs(segs[1].distance_inches - 3.0) <= 0.1 and segs[1].from.distance_to(Vector2(120, 220)) < 0.5
